classification.difficultyReason: Identify the cylinder height as the sphere diameter and simplify a volume ratio.

content.prompt: A sphere of radius $r$ is inscribed in a cylinder. What fraction of the cylinder is taken up by the sphere?

spec.description: An unshaded sphere inside an upright cylinder; the sphere touches both ends and the curved wall. The equator has a dashed rear arc and solid front arc, and a centre-to-rim radius is labelled r.
spec.mathematics: Sphere and cylinder radius r; cylinder height 2r.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied radius label is visible; no volume or fraction is supplied.

answer.worked:
The cylinder has radius $r$ and height $2r$.

$$\begin{align*}V_{\text{sphere}}&=\frac43\pi r^3\\V_{\text{cylinder}}&=\pi r^2(2r)\\V_{\text{cylinder}}&=2\pi r^3\\\frac{V_{\text{sphere}}}{V_{\text{cylinder}}}&=\frac{\frac43\pi r^3}{2\pi r^3}\\\frac{V_{\text{sphere}}}{V_{\text{cylinder}}}&=\frac23\end{align*}$$
